questions.name: Selector
questions.question_text:
A developer needs the first required email field on a page. Which method correctly completes the code below?

const field = document.???('input[type="email"][required]')

questions.name: Event listener
questions.question_text:
A button should call saveProfile only when the user clicks it. The current code runs saveProfile immediately during page load:

button.addEventListener('click', saveProfile())

Which change fixes the problem?

answers.text: Clear labels and error text tied to their fields
answers.html: Clear labels and error text tied to their fields

answers.text: A red border on each field that fails validation
answers.html: A red border on each field that fails validation

answers.text: Placeholder text describing the expected format
An alert() dialog listing every error at once
answers.html: An alert() dialog listing every error at once

questions.name: Prevent default
questions.question_text: Inside a form submit handler, calling event.preventDefault() keeps the browser from submitting the form immediately so custom validation can run first.

questions.name: State source
questions.question_text: A validation script needs the text the user has actually typed into an <input>. Which value should it read?

answers.text: The text content of the surrounding label
answers.html: The text content of the surrounding label

answers.text: The value attribute written in the HTML source
answers.html: The value attribute written in the HTML source

answers.text: The placeholder text shown in the field
answers.html: The placeholder text shown in the field
